disposition_reason: In vitro pharmacology of a synthetic vanadium-protein complex in human preadipocytes; viability check only, no exposure or occurrence data.

study.method: EZ-cytox viability, Oil Red O, TG assay, Western blot; vanadium content by ICP-OES

non_numeric_findings: No adverse viability effect at 5 to 20 µg/mL of the complex; 40 µg/mL reduced viability by up to 17.25% at day 14 (pp. 5 to 6)
Funding statement: Haizhibao company supported travel and consulting incentives for one author (p. 2)
